goal: Define safe low-cardinality labels and payload fields for Loki, Prometheus and Grafana dashboards before broad Odysseus log shipping is enabled.

metric_families.name: odysseus_runtime_events_total
metric_families.description: Count of redacted runtime events by bounded label set.

metric_families.name: odysseus_runtime_event_duration_seconds
metric_families.description: Duration of event-producing operations such as Telegram reply, Inbox extraction, scheduler delivery and model calls.

metric_families.name: odysseus_runtime_failures_total
metric_families.description: Failures and blocked events by bounded operational source.

metric_families.name: odysseus_live_gate_open_total
metric_families.description: Open gates that require operator action, without embedding action ids or private context as labels.

questions_answered: Are replies being sent or blocked?
Are voice, OCR or document pipelines failing?
dashboard_sections.privacy_note: Show counts and statuses only; message text and raw chat ids never appear.
Reminder content and calendar titles stay out of labels and shared logs.

questions_answered: Did memory or graph provenance write?
dashboard_sections.privacy_note: Use doc ids and source hashes only in payloads, not labels.

questions_answered: Are agent runs blocked by gates?
dashboard_sections.privacy_note: Prompt hashes, token counts and model refs are allowed; raw prompts and outputs are not.

questions_answered: Which components are producing security alerts?
Which actions are waiting for operator approval?
dashboard_sections.privacy_note: Attacker identifiers and IPs are not labels; approved defensive actions may reference redacted payload refs.

retention_defaults.runtime_event_jsonl: 30d local default before rotation policy is finalized

acceptance_checks: No forbidden label appears in metrics or Loki labels.
No raw content fields appear in runtime event payloads.
Correlation ids are queryable through payload fields or MCP, not high-cardinality labels.
Dashboards can answer Telegram, scheduler, inbox, memory, model and security status questions from bounded labels.
